# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames

# All source tables have the same schema as the target, so union (concat) all
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema:
# 'anime_id': integer
# 'name': string
# 'genre': string
# 'type': string
# 'episodes': integer
# 'rating': float
# 'members': integer

# Convert columns to correct types
target_df['anime_id'] = target_df['anime_id'].astype(int)
target_df['name'] = target_df['name'].astype(str)
target_df['genre'] = target_df['genre'].astype(str)
target_df['type'] = target_df['type'].astype(str)
target_df['episodes'] = target_df['episodes'].astype(int)
target_df['rating'] = target_df['rating'].astype(float)
target_df['members'] = target_df['members'].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_75/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
